      simpa [Multiset.mem_map] using hx₁

theorem X {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {u v : V} : G.Adj u v → 2 ≤ G.chromaticNumber := by
  intro h_adj
  have h_main : 2 ≤ G.chromaticNumber := by
    -- Use the fact that if there is an edge, the chromatic number must be at least 2.
    have h₁ : G.Adj u v := h_adj
    have h₂ : 2 ≤ G.chromaticNumber := by
      -- Use the property of the chromatic number for a graph with an edge.
      by_contra h
      -- If the chromatic number is not at least 2, it must be 0 or 1.
      have h₃ : G.chromaticNumber ≤ 1 := by linarith
      -- Use the fact that if the graph has an edge, its chromatic number cannot be 0 or 1.
      have h₄ : G.Adj u v := h₁
      have h₅ : G.chromaticNumber = 0 ∨ G.chromaticNumber = 1 := by
        omega
      cases h₅ with
      | inl h₅ =>
        -- If the chromatic number is 0, there are no edges.
        have h₆ : ¬G.Adj u v := by
          simp_all [SimpleGraph.not_adjacent_iff]
          <;> aesop
        exact absurd h₄ h₆
      | inr h₅ =>
        -- If the chromatic number is 1, all vertices must be the same color.
        have h₆ : u = v := by
          have h₆₁ : G.chromaticNumber = 1 := h₅
          have h₆₂ : ∀ (x y : V), x ∈ G.vertices → y ∈ G.vertices → G.Adj x y → x = y := by
            intro x y hx hy hxy
            have h₆₃ : G.chromaticNumber = 1 := h₅
            have h₆₄ : ∀ (x y : V), x ∈ G.vertices → y ∈ G.vertices → G.Adj x y → x = y := by
              intro x y hx hy hxy
              -- Use the fact that if the chromatic number is 1, all vertices must be the same color.
              have h₆₅ : ∀ (x y : V), x ∈ G.vertices → y ∈ G.vertices → G.Adj x y → x = y := by
                intro x y hx hy hxy
                -- Use the fact that if the chromatic number is 1, all vertices must be the same color.
                simp_all [SimpleGraph.chromaticNumber_eq_one_iff]
                <;> aesop
              exact h₆₅ x y hx hy hxy
            exact h₆₄ x y hx hy hxy
          have h₆₃ : u ∈ G.vertices := by
            apply SimpleGraph.mem_vertices.mpr
            exact ⟨u, by simp⟩
          have h₆₄ : v ∈ G.vertices := by
            apply SimpleGraph.mem_vertices.mpr
            exact ⟨v, by simp⟩
          have h₆₅ : G.Adj u v := h₁
          have h₆₆ : u = v := h₆₂ u v h₆₃ h₆₄ h₆₅
          exact h₆₆
        -- If u = v, then the graph cannot have an edge.
        simp_all [SimpleGraph.not_adjacent_iff]
        <;> aesop
    exact h₂
